answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 22182 Country: Pakistan Title: Pls. guide How to perform QAZA Namaz in sequence. For example, if one missed the fajar prayer. Then he should perform Zohar prayer first or the Qaza of Fajar first. In the same way how to perform the qaza namaz which are left in past. Can Qaza prayers be performed after completing the farz prayer of the time. How if one wants to perform the past qaza prayers of life with every namaz. Question: Pls. guide How to perform QAZA Namaz in sequence. For example, if one missed the fajar prayer. Then he should perform Zohar prayer first or the Qaza of Fajar first. In the same way how to perform the qaza namaz which are left in past. Can Qaza prayers be performed after completing the farz prayer of the time. How if one wants to perform the past qaza prayers of life with every namaz. Answer ID: 22182 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 895/710/B=1431) First he should offer Fajr salah and then Zuhar . And if he missed too many salah then he should offer only the qaza of fardh salah as much as he can. After offering each time salah he should offer the qaza salah of the same time i.e. after offering Fajr salah he should offer the qaza of Fajr salah, or if he can he should offer qaza of more than one salah, and as much as qaza salah he offers he should note it in a notebook. The intention should be made in this way: I am offering my first missed Fajr salah amongst my all qaza salah, or I am offering my first qaza of Zuhar salah. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
